7421-poems-of-optimism.title: Poems Of Optimism
7421-poems-of-optimism.creator: Unknown
7421-poems-of-optimism.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Our hearts were not set on fighting,  We did not pant for the fray,  And whatever wrongs need righting,  We would not have met that way. But the way that has opened before us  Leads on thro’ a blood-red field;  And we swear by the great God o’er us,  We will die, but we will not yield.

arxiv-2008-11794.title: Domain wall topological entanglement entropy
arxiv-2008-11794.creator: Bowen Shi, Isaac H. Kim
arxiv-2008-11794.description: Abstract We study the ground-state entanglement of gapped domain walls between topologically ordered systems in two spatial dimensions. We derive a universal correction to the ground-state entanglement entropy, which is equal to the logarithm of the total quantum dimension of a set of superselection sectors localized on the domain wall.

arxiv-2410-22625.title: Non-Equilibrium Dynamics of Hybrid Continuous-Discrete Ground-State Sampling
arxiv-2410-22625.creator: Timothée Leleu, Samuel Reifenstein
arxiv-2410-22625.description: Abstract We propose a general framework for a hybrid continuous-discrete algorithm that integrates continuous-time deterministic dynamics with Metropolis-Hastings steps to combine search dynamics with and without detailed balance. Our purpose is to study the non-equilibrium dynamics that leads to the ground state of rugged energy landscapes in this general setting.

arxiv-2507-22695.title: Maximal average over surfaces of codimension 2 in ℝ 4 \mathbb{R}^{4}
arxiv-2507-22695.creator: Seheon Ham, Hyerim Ko
arxiv-2507-22695.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Seheon Ham, Hyerim Ko. In this paper, we obtain sharp L p L^{p} improving estimates for maximal averages over nondegenerate surfaces of codimension 2 2 in ℝ 4 \mathbb{R}^{4} . We also establish local smoothing type estimates for the averages, which are accomplished by making use of multilinear restriction estimates and decoupling inequalities for two dimensional conic extension of two dimensional nondegenerate surfaces. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 42B25 1. Introduction Let d\geq 2 .

arxiv-2508-15801.title: LingVarBench: Benchmarking LLM for Automated Named Entity Recognition in Structured Synthetic Spoken Transcriptions
arxiv-2508-15801.creator: Seyedali Mohammadi, Manas Paldhe, Amit Chhabra
arxiv-2508-15801.description: Abstract Phone call transcript labeling is prohibitively expensive ( $2 per minute) due to privacy regulations, consent requirements, and manual annotation costs requiring 3 hours of expert time per hour of audio. Existing extraction methods fail on conversational speech containing disfluencies, interruptions, and speaker overlap.

A magnesium oxysulfate (MOS) grout formulation has been proposed to solidify the liquid effluent from the Savannah River Plutonium Processing Facility (SRPPF) Aqueous Recovery System (ARS). pmc-10736576.title: CONTACT-FREE SPORTS ACTIVITIES DURING COVID-19: IMPACT ON SUBJECTIVE HEALTH AND STAMINA AMONG KOREAN OLDER ADULTS
pmc-10736576.creator: Gaeun Han, Juhyeong Lee, Giyeon Kim
pmc-10736576.description: Despite the importance of participation in sports activities among older adults, COVID-19 pandemic has limited access to sports facilities, which may threaten the physical and mental health of older adults. This study examines whether the relationship between age and subjective health and stamina is moderated by participation in contact-free sports activities among Korean older adults.

pmc-11344073.title: Additive genotoxic effects in cord blood cells upon indirect exposure to chemotherapeutic compounds crossing an in vitro placental barrier
pmc-11344073.creator: Carolina Velazquez, Lien Loier, Ilana Struys, Eline Verscheure, Leentje Persoons, Lode Godderis, Liesbeth Lenaerts, Frédéric Amant
pmc-11344073.description: Prenatal exposure to toxins can adversely affect long-term health outcomes of the offspring. Though chemotherapeutics are now standard of care for treating cancer patients during pregnancy, certain compounds are known to cross the placenta and harm placental tissue. The consequences for the fetus are largely unexplored.

pmc-11360251.title: Effects of Contamination with Selected Polymers on the Mechanical Properties of Post-Industrial Recycled Polypropylene
pmc-11360251.creator: Michael Dawoud, Iman Taha
pmc-11360251.description: The effect of contamination of polypropylene (PP) with selected polymers is studied to simulate the effect of mis-sorting in recycling streams. Polystyrene (PS), polyethylene terephthalate (PET), polycarbonate (PC), acrylonitrile butadiene styrene (ABS), and polylactic acid (PLA) were compounded with PP at different concentrations varying between 3 and 10%. Infrared spectroscopy proved the absence of chemical bonds between the constituents.

pmc-11396117.title: Severe Hypertension in Pregnancy: Progress Made and Future Directions for Patient Safety, Quality Improvement, and Implementation of a Patient Safety Bundle
pmc-11396117.creator: Alissa Prior, Isabel Taylor, Kelly S. Gibson, Christie Allen
pmc-11396117.description: Hypertensive disorders of pregnancy account for approximately 5% of pregnancy-related deaths in the United States and are one of the leading causes of maternal morbidity. Focus on improving patient outcomes in the setting of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy has increased in recent years, and quality improvement initiatives have been implemented across the United States.

pmc-11472824.title: Unraveling cell wall polysaccharides during blueberry ripening: insights into the roles of rhamnogalacturonan-I and arabinogalactan proteins in fruit firmness
pmc-11472824.creator: Dayan Sanhueza, Iván Balic-Norambuena, Pablo Sepúlveda-Orellana, Sebastián Siña-López, Adrián A. Moreno, María Alejandra Moya-León, Susana Saez-Aguayo
pmc-11472824.description: Blueberries (Vaccinium corymbosum) undergo significant texture changes during development and ripening, notably a consistent decrease in firmness, which affects fruit quality, consumer preference, transportability, and shelf life. This study examined the composition and structural modifications of the cell wall in five commercially available blueberry varieties with differing firmness levels at harvest.

pmc-11483550.title: Quantitative Susceptibility Mapping Values Quantification in Deep Gray Matter Structures for Relapsing‐Remitting Multiple Sclerosis: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
pmc-11483550.creator: Sana Mohammadi, Sadegh Ghaderi, Farzad Fatehi
pmc-11483550.description: Background/ObjectivesThis systematic review and meta‐analysis aimed to investigate the role of magnetic susceptibility (χ) in deep gray matter (DGM) structures, including the putamen (PUT), globus pallidus (GP), caudate nucleus (CN), and thalamus, in the most common types of multiple sclerosis (MS) and relapsing‐remitting MS (RRMS), using quantitative susceptibility mapping (QSM).

pmc-11506622.title: The Effect of Multi-Strategy Nutrition Education Programs on Hedonic Hunger and Nutrition Status in Adolescents
pmc-11506622.creator: Osman Bozkurt, Hilal Yildiran, Antonela Matana, Sanja Music Milanovic, Marko Šimunović
pmc-11506622.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Objective: Increasing the awareness of adolescents about hedonic hunger, understanding the difference between homeostatic hunger and hedonic hunger, and adolescents learning to control themselves to stop excessive food consumption are extremely important for a healthy adulthood. The study aimed to evaluate the effects of the multi-strategy nutrition education programs (MSNEP) on hedonic hunger, food addiction, nutrition literacy, and nutritional status in adolescents. Methods: This study was planned using a pre-test and post-test design.

pmc-11575116.title: miRNA-431-5p enriched in EVs derived from IFN-β stimulated MSCs potently inhibited ZIKV through CD95 downregulation
pmc-11575116.creator: Meng Yuan, Xiaoyan Tian, Wenyuan Ma, Rui Zhang, Xue Zou, Yu Jin, Nan Zheng, Zhiwei Wu, Yongxiang Wang
pmc-11575116.description: BackgroundZika virus (ZIKV) primarily spreads through mosquito bites and can lead to microcephaly in infants and Guillain-Barre syndrome in adults. It is noteworthy that ZIKV can persist in the semen of infected males for extended periods and can be sexually transmitted.

pmc-11677960.title: Boldenone and Testosterone Production from Phytosterol via One-Pot Cascade Biotransformations
pmc-11677960.creator: Vyacheslav V Kollerov, Tatiana A Timakova, Andrei A Shutov, Marina V Donova, Edvaldo Antonio Ribeiro Rosa, Sanjai Saxena
pmc-11677960.description: Testosterone (TS) and its 1(2)-dehydrogenated derivative boldenone (BD) are widely used in medicine, veterinary science and as precursors in organic synthesis of many therapeutic steroids. Green production of these compounds is possible from androstenedione (AD) enzymatically, or from phytosterol (PS) using fermentation stages. In this study, the ascomycete Curvularia sp.

pmc-13181838.title: Thermal Damage to the Skin From 5.6 GHz Microwave Exposures in Swine
pmc-13181838.creator: James E Parker, Roberto A Rodriguez, Clarissa D Vázquez‐Colón, Randolph Stone, Joseph W Butterworth, Jeffrey N Whitmore, Jason A Payne, William B Voorhees
pmc-13181838.description: A study of burn thresholds from superficially penetrating radio‐frequency (RF) energy at 5.6 GHz for swine skin was conducted. The study estimated the thresholds for superficial, partial‐thickness, and full‐thickness burn severities after 20 s of exposure at power densities of 4–8 W/cm2. Biopsies were collected from each burn site at 1, 24, 72, and 168 h post exposure.

pmc-13192368.title: Hand to Mouth: Shifting the Bare-Minimum Accessibility Paradigm in XR Through Crip-Hacking and Crip-Aesthetics
pmc-13192368.creator: Puneet Jain, Christian Bayerlein
pmc-13192368.description: eXtended Reality (XR) technologies often embed ableist design assumptions, privileging hand-based interaction and vision-centric interfaces that presume a normative able-bodied user. As a result, many disabled people—including those with limited mobility or blindness—are excluded from the outset, with accessibility added only as an afterthought.

pmc-13317952.title: An assessment of cyber security and resilience of the National Digital Health Mission of India
pmc-13317952.creator: Suresh Renukappa, Chandrashekar Subbarao, Subashini Suresh, Prashant Pillai, Kieran Fernando, Chandrashekar Rangaswamy, Jayakar Shetty, Rajeev Krishnadas, Tonny Veenith
pmc-13317952.description: The healthcare sector has undergone a transformation driven by the adoption of digital technology. Digital strategies have become the principal mechanism for delivering high-quality, cost-effective healthcare at scale. The Indian Government is also rapidly deploying the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), launched in September 2021.

pmc-13369809.title: Sustainable science mapping: benchmarking green AI against transformers for cross-disciplinary abstract classification using arXiv
pmc-13369809.creator: Mehmet Ali Erkan, Ceylan Yozgatlıgil
pmc-13369809.description: The exponential growth of scholarly literature necessitates automated, scalable systems for organizing knowledge domains. However, text classification of academic abstracts presents distinct challenges due to specialized terminology and diverse discourse structures across disciplines. This study proposes a resource efficient deep learning methodology to categorize academic abstracts, scaling from coarse grained domains (arXiv) to fine grained disciplinary hierarchies (Web of Science).
